title: Run offline device restore and migration release acceptance
description: Verify airplane mode core flows, multiple aquariums, migration from previous fixture, backup recovery after reinstall/manual copy and no embedded secrets/network dependency. Prepare in-app Apache2.0 and third-party notices, privacy/store disclosures and informational limitations for species/dosing; review dependency and generated-asset rights before publication.
design: Use RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR. See approved design; proposals need confirmation before implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Record device/API matrix, export/import/export equality, interruption rollback, SAF revocation, fresh-clone CI build and release artifact review. In-app license/third-party notices are accessible and complete; privacy/store disclosures match actual collection, permissions and backup behavior; species/dosing limitations avoid safety guarantees or invented advice. Verify applicable PixelLab terms before distributing generated assets. No blanket legal immunity claims, custom Apache restrictions or source-only acceptance.
notes: Read-only Room slice native smoke on the owned headless API 36.1 AVD (2026-10-19) passed empty rendering after the observed Wait action dismissed a System UI ANR predating app launch by about 7 minutes. Retained logs show cold Displayed/launch 11.814s and 316 skipped frames: performance is NOT accepted, and the cause is not yet attributed. Before release, measure cold/warm startup and frame timing on stable representative API 23/API 36 devices; distinguish emulator boot/resource contention from application startup. Evidence: docs/verification.md and ignored .toolchain/room-audit-clean.png, room-audit-stable.png, room-audit-after.xml. Native populated/error/retry rendering, TalkBack, large font and multiple sizes remain future acceptance.
